flank_parameterization_option.definition: Use two distinct planar cubic B-spline generator functions C_left(u) and C_right(v) in the x-z plane at y=-124 mm. Initialize each from its own observed 7 source control-point x/z coordinates and its own full knot vector; expose every x/z control coordinate as an independent editable parameter, keep that curve’s own recorded knot vector fixed initially, and do not tie opposite sides by reflection. The numbers are starting values, not fixed control points or an imported-body substitute.

flank_fin_sp_section_analysis.semantic_contract: Within a consistent UF_BREP face tree and its own converted root EXTRUDE representation, U of a FIN SP is the generator parameter. A section boundary may be obtained by intersecting the FIN SP with a same-tree cross-section SP and evaluating the original generator at that raw U. This is exact as a calculation on the returned representations; source geometry correspondence retains native approximation/frame uncertainty.

same_tree_findings.section_selection: The 3D FIN-owned horizontal edge lies at y=-71; its same-loop SP has V=-0.05299999999999999. Both longitudinal FIN SPs meet that same V at one of their own endpoints. This is a same-tree section choice, not AskFaceUvMinmax or an original pole.
same_tree_findings.support_interpretation: Support analysis is for the recorded decimal U envelope of the four observed FIN SP curves and the original B-spline basis; it assumes the selected interval describes the candidate section, not exact source-trim or constraint solvability. The extreme tiny weights are real in this recorded-number model but are below meaningful extraction uncertainty and must not be snapped to zero or promoted as independent drivers.

same_tree_findings.section_selection: The 3D FIN-owned horizontal edge lies at y=-71; its same-loop SP has V=-0.05299999999999999. Both longitudinal FIN SPs meet that same V at one of their own endpoints. This is a same-tree section choice, not AskFaceUvMinmax or an original pole.

The extreme tiny weights are real in this recorded-number model but are below meaningful extraction uncertainty and must not be snapped to zero or promoted as independent drivers.

flank_fin_sp_section_analysis.bound_derivation: For a nonrational cubic spline C(u)=sum_i N_i,3(u) P_i, derivative Cprime is a degree-2 B-spline with Q_i=3*(P_(i+1)-P_i)/(t_(i+4)-t_(i+1)). Since its nonnegative basis weights sum to 1, norm(Cprime(u)) <= max_i norm(Q_i), so norm(C(u2)-C(u1)) <= L*abs(u2-u1) on the domain. 1.41410 mm/U is an outward-rounded bound above both calculated control-vector norms. This bound is for the returned generators only, excludes SP-to-native mismatch, and is not a manufacturing, model, or acceptance tolerance.
flank_fin_sp_section_analysis.v_scale_and_frame: For these two records only, observed SP V=-0.053 maps to edge y=-71 while generator y=-124 and direction is [0,-1,0]; observed V=-0.0014 maps to y=-122.6, consistent numerically with y=-124-1000*V. The header states V in part units, so this local 1000 relation is an unresolved representation/unit inconsistency, not a generally validated transform. U extraction at the existing y=-71 shared FIN endpoint does not require V-to-world conversion. Arbitrary world-y sections require a justified source-frame/V mapping or a separate same-tree section intersection with recorded correspondence.
strict_remaining_gaps: UF_BREP permits an SP or 3D curve to be computed by approximation; the numerical correspondence accuracy for these specific FINs/edges is not established by the requested 0.001 setting, especially for preexisting tolerant edges.
The source-frame/unit mapping responsible for V scale must be resolved before interpreting arbitrary 3D sections or claiming S(u,v) world coordinates.
Confirm loop/FIN direction, trimming and selected section applicability, plus endpoint-to-adjacent-carrier constraints, before declaring a closed editable engineering section.

Raw generators differ and P0/P6 support can be exactly zero or minuscule in the recorded-number model; mathematical nonzero influence alone does not prove usable independent design degrees of freedom, constraint solvability or permitted edit ranges.
